procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
HKG was represented by ZiYan Huang
RC was represented by LEON ZHOU course A representative and gave traker evidences

HKG failed to deliver the request for redress within the protest time limit, as required by RRS 61.2(b)(1). Once ashore HKG, returned the boat to her assigned place, dropped the mainsail, load the mast due to the wind and all gusts experienced in the boat park, gave back the tracking system and immediatelly submitted the request for redess in the system. Therefore, was good reason for the international jury to extend the time limit.
HKG requested to change the race number becouse the incident occured in R2 and not in R3.
facts: At the time of the incident the wind speed was 20 knots with gusts up to 30 knots and the waves were approximatelly 2.5 meters.
HKG was sailing on starboard tack on the first upwind leg, approaching the windward mark.
While approaching the mark, the boat heeled to leeward, the boom touched the water, and the boat capsized 1,5 boat length to windward side of the mark.
The windward mark was a robotic / self-propelled mark, equipped with propellers.
Due to strong wind and waves, the mark was holding its position.
HKG was drifting towards the mark and the mainsheet became caught on the robotic mark.
While the mark’s propellers were operating, the mainsheet became entangled in the propellers.
After few minutes the RC approched HKG and untangled the mainsheet.
The boat remained tangled for several minutes.
At the moment of the incident HKG was approximatelly in 30th place.
After the incident, HKG sailed towards the finishing line and she was scored DNF by the RC.
conclusions: The entanglement with the mark occurred after the capsize and was a consequence of HKG's loss of control, not an improper action or omission by the race committee.
HKG’s score was made significantly worse through her own fault by capsizing therefore, the requirements for redress under RRS 61.4(b) are not met.
